issues.where: the whole inside of the glass (set-B-02 crops 1-6, set-B-03 crop 7)
issues.what: the swirling snow reads as long, smooth, evenly bright white brushstrokes laid flat over the scene. They all sit at one depth, the same arcs run right to the rim, and none of them break into flakes. The globe reads as a milky painted ball, and the tree is lost completely
issues.fix: render the swirl as volumetric flakes at several depths with short, varied motion streaks: sharp near the focus plane, soft and larger near the glass, thinning toward the back. Keep the cottage, tree and lights readable through gaps in the swirl

issues.what: the smoke stays a straight vertical white column while all the liquid around it swirls, so it reads as a pasted element that ignores the flow
issues.fix: bend and shred the plume with the swirl, or remove the smoke inside the liquid

issues.where: small orange flecks throughout the swirl (set-B-02 crops 1, 2, 4)
issues.what: short orange dashes like embers float in the liquid with no source and no glow around them
issues.fix: remove them, or make them the out-of-focus glints of the tree and cottage lights, soft and coloured by those lights

issues.where: the inside seen through the glass, worst toward the rim (set-A-02 crops 2, 3, 4; set-C-01)
issues.what: the cottage, tree and ground show almost no magnification or bending near the edge of the water-filled sphere. The scene looks as if it sits behind flat glass, and the ground simply stops at the glass outline
issues.fix: add real refraction for a solid liquid sphere: magnify the centre, squeeze and bend the scene toward the rim, and add a thin band where the inside flips or mirrors at the very edge

issues.where: the chimney smoke (set-C-02 crop 2; also set-A-02 crop 1)
issues.what: the smoke is a perfectly straight, even cone of fine white grain, like a particle spray emitter. It has no curl and does not thin out at the top
issues.fix: give it soft drift, curl and fade, or remove it, since smoke does not rise as a column inside liquid

issues.where: crop 9, and set-B-03 crops 9 and 10: the gold ring seen through the bottom of the glass above the collar
issues.what: a thin gold bar runs across behind the glass and stops in mid-air on the left, with no join to the collar. It reads as a stray floating rod
issues.fix: make the inner ring a complete circle that meets the collar, or hide it behind the snow on the seat

issues.where: the snow bed cross-section in the lower bowl (set-C-03 crops 10, 11; set-A-02 crop 5)
issues.what: the snow mass against the glass is one smooth grey-white band with the same few dark smudges in A and C. It looks like a stained painted texture, with no grain, no packing and no bend from the glass
issues.fix: give the snow mass a fine granular surface where it meets the glass, refracted by the curve, and remove the repeated dark smudge pattern

issues.where: the line where the base meets the surface, and the mirror image (set-A-03 crops 10-12)
issues.what: the surface reads as glossy: the bokeh reflects as a bright band on the right. Yet the brightly lit gold rope ring and the dark base leave almost no mirror image below the contact line. Only a dark band and the frost show there
issues.fix: add a soft, darkened mirror image of the rope ring and base that is sharp at the contact line and blurs with distance, broken up where the frost lies

issues.where: crop 6 around the chimney, and particles near the glass in set-A-02 crop 6
issues.what: some flakes are clear cross or x-shaped sprites. Most near flakes are similar sharp flat dots with few out of focus
issues.fix: vary the flake shapes into irregular clumps, and defocus more of the flakes nearest and farthest from the focus plane

issues.where: the top of the glass (set-A-02 crop 1, top right)
issues.what: an oval highlight with a hard-edged inner ring reads as a moulded cap or dimple in the glass, not a reflection
issues.fix: soften it into an ordinary softbox reflection that follows the curve, or remove it

issues.where: what lies on the surface around the base (set-A-03 crops 11, 12)
issues.what: the frost ferns are nearly uniform flat white with little relief. They spread symmetrically from the foot like a decal
issues.fix: vary the frost's density and thickness, let it thin and turn clear at the tips, and break the symmetry around the foot
